title: An old record by Arthur Pryor's band and the Vanguard 78s
summary: Dickenson finds a record of a military bandleader and shows his original Vanguard 78s.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: Usually they say, because there are not too many recorded examples of trombones playing ballad style until maybe some early Tommy Dorsey things.
I've got a (?) record here that somebody gave me up in Boston, of Arthur Pryor(singing)Aida.
Yes, he had a military band, it seemed like...
Yes. I wonder what I did with that record. I'm sure I (?). I'll go get it and show it to you...
Small records, yeah. You know... These are the Vanguard...
Oh, the Vanguards. Those were nice.
This is two of them. I didn't get the other two. I wish I could find them.
